# Introduction

Unadjusted ANCOVA analyses using all data (Eng + Fr speakers). These analyses 
compare Week 16 outcomes between treatment groups while adjusting for 
baseline values and site (and total number of utterances for the ELS measures).

## Demographics for ELS ANCOVA Subjects

The following tables present baseline demographic characteristics limited to 
subjects with complete ANCOVA data for ELS outcomes, stratified by:
1. All subjects
2. Age 6-11 (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)
3. Age 12+ (with p-values for Met vs. Placebo within this age group)

{{< include _demographics_ancova_els.qmd >}}

## ANCOVA Analyses (Unadjusted)

{{< include _ancova_unadjusted.qmd >}}

## Primary Unadjusted ANCOVA Results Table

```{r}
#| label: primary-ancova-unadjusted-table
#| include: false

# Primary outcomes table (ELS only)
primary_ancova_unadj_summary <- els_ancova_unadj_summary
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-primary-ancova-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Primary Unadjusted ANCOVA Results - ELS Outcomes. Unadjusted ANCOVA results showing LS means (95% CI) for baseline and 16-week change, and between-group difference in changes (not adjusted for demographics). {data_caption}")

primary_ancova_unadj_ft <- primary_ancova_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome, n_p, baseline_p, baseline_p_ci, p_change, p_change_ci,
    n_m, baseline_m, baseline_m_ci, m_change, m_change_ci,
    baseline_contrast_mean, baseline_contrast_ci,
    contrast_mean, contrast_ci, contrast_p
  ) |> 
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "ELS Outcome",
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "LS Mean",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "LS Mean",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "LS Mean",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "LS Mean",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "LS Mean",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "LS Mean",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_p = "p-value"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "",
               "Baseline", "16-week Change", "", 
               rep(c("Baseline", "16-week Change"), 2)),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3)
  ) |> 
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Metformin vs. Placebo"),
    colwidths = c(1, 5, 5, 5)
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "Within-Group Comparison", "Between-Group Comparison"),
    colwidths = c(1, 10, 5)
  ) |> 
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 4, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = c(1, 2, 3), align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(1, 6, 11), part = "all") |>
  flextable::vline(
    j = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15),
    part = "header",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |>
  flextable::vline(
    j = c(2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 13, 15),
    part = "body",
    border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |>
   flextable::hline(
     i = c(1, 3),
     part = "header",
     border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
   ) |>
   flextable::hline(
     i = nrow(primary_ancova_unadj_summary),
     part = "body",
     border = officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
  ) |> 
  flextable::autofit()

primary_ancova_unadj_ft
```

## Secondary Unadjusted ANCOVA Results Table

```{r}
#| label: secondary-ancova-unadjusted-table
#| include: false

# Filter Vineland to Raw Score and Standard Score outcomes
vabs_unadj_raw_stnd_only <- vabs_ancova_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(Outcome, "Raw Score") | 
                  stringr::str_detect(Outcome, "Standard Score"))

# Combine all secondary outcomes (with filtered Vineland)
secondary_ancova_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    bmi_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "BMI",
        .before = 1
      ),
    abc_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "ABC",
        .before = 1
      ),
    adams_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "ADAMS",
        .before = 1
      ),
    pql_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Peds QL",
        .before = 1
      ),
    cshq_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "CSHQ",
        .before = 1
      ),
    snap_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "SNAP-IV",
        .before = 1
      ),
    vas_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "VAS",
        .before = 1
      ),
    vabs_unadj_raw_stnd_only |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Vineland",
        .before = 1
      ),
    biomarker_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Biomarkers",
        .before = 1
      ),
    tlbx_ancova_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Toolbox",
        .before = 1
      ),
    eye_ancova_z_unadj_summary |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Instrument = "Eye Tracking",
        .before = 1
      )
) |> 
  flextable::as_grouped_data(groups = "Instrument") |> 
  dplyr::mutate(
    Outcome = ifelse(
      is.na(Outcome),
      Instrument,
      Outcome
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: export-tables
#| echo: false
#| include: false

strata <- "all_data_unadjusted"

# Create workbook
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_workbook()

# Add each ANCOVA table as a separate sheet with flextable formatting
wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Demographics")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(
  wb, sheet = "Demographics", ft = demog_merged_ft, 
  start_col = 3, start_row = 3
)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "ELS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "ELS", ft = els_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "BMI")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "BMI", ft = bmi_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "ABC")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "ABC", ft = abc_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "ADAMS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "ADAMS", ft = adams_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Peds QL")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Peds QL", ft = pql_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "CSHQ")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "CSHQ", ft = cshq_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "SNAP-IV")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "SNAP-IV", ft = snap_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "VAS")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "VAS", ft = vas_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "CGI")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "CGI", ft = cgi_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Vineland")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Vineland", ft = vabs_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Biomarkers")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Biomarkers", ft = biomarker_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Toolbox")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Toolbox", ft = tlbx_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Eye Tracking")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Eye Tracking", ft = eye_ancova_z_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Primary Results")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Primary Results", 
                                ft = primary_ancova_unadj_ft)

wb <- openxlsx2::wb_add_worksheet(wb, sheet = "Secondary Results")
wb <- flexlsx::wb_add_flextable(wb, sheet = "Secondary Results", 
                                ft = secondary_ancova_unadj_ft)

# Save model result tables (not flextables) for each instrument
ancova_model_results_tables <- list(
  ELS = els_ancova_unadj_summary,
  BMI = bmi_ancova_unadj_summary,
  ABC = abc_ancova_unadj_summary,
  ADAMS = adams_ancova_unadj_summary,
  PedsQL = pql_ancova_unadj_summary,
  CSHQ = cshq_ancova_unadj_summary,
  `SNAP-IV` = snap_ancova_unadj_summary,
  VAS = vas_ancova_unadj_summary,
  CGI = cgi_ancova_unadj_summary,
  Vineland = vabs_ancova_unadj_summary,
  Biomarkers = biomarker_ancova_unadj_summary,
  Toolbox = tlbx_ancova_unadj_summary,
  `Eye Tracking` = eye_ancova_z_unadj_summary
)

saveRDS(
  object = ancova_model_results_tables,
  file = glue::glue("metformin_{strata}_ancova_model_results_tables.rds")
)

# Save workbook
openxlsx2::wb_save(
  wb = wb,
  file = glue::glue("metformin_{strata}_ancova_tables.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)
```
